Where do you get your supplements and powders?

All I take is vitamin D, protein powder, and fish oil. Vitamin D is super cheap on amazon, so no problem there. Everyone who lives outside of the tropics should be taking the stuff, so many diseases would be reduced dramatically. Fish oil is costlier, I found 300 1000mg cap bottles for nine bucks at one of those bulk grocery stores once so I bought a ton, it's good quality stuff and I haven't run out yet. I have multiple sources; sometimes it's cheaper on amazon, sometimes on another place I frequently buy from, and sometimes in some place I find through google.

So first I check amazon, then a website called 'Powder City' if I'm going to get a powder (they used to be called 'Health Supplement Wholesalers', I have no idea why they changed the name and the bags in which they ship the supplements, but the quality has remained the same so I've stuck to them), then 'Swanson Health Products' if I'm going to get a pill; these two last websites have been on average the cheapest places that I have never had a quality issue with (well, one time Powder City sent a plastic container with a small cosmetic defect outside, but the supplements have always been fine). After checking those 3 sites, I do a quick google anyway, in case I find some better place; however note that I'd prefer to stick to a few known places, instead of spreading credit card into across the entire internet. I've paid a few bucks more to use amazon instead of a random place I've never heard of.

Do mind the shipping, which newcomers to buying online sometimes disregard. I also look for coupons on google but these usually just take a small amount of the cost off (so most of the time it's not worth it), and I don't go looking for offers, but I welcome offers about items I planned to buy anyway, even if I wasn't going to buy it just yet.

Once I find a place where the item is the cheapest, I usually keep ordering the same item from them without checking other websites, unless they change prices or stop stocking it. Just by doing this, I consistently get stuff half the price of other people I know, that buy online... do note that after trying a shitload of supplements, the only ones I use (even outside of the fitness realm) are coffee, theanine and creatine. I get my protein from meat and beans mostly.
